name: cap-brainstorm-pairing
description: The pairing/ideas capability behind chat-agent's brainstorm_pairing tool. Three wf-step-llm calls — parse, propose, compose — around two wf-step-retrieve calls (the anchor ingredient, and its style/technique context), with a pure-code grounding step between propose and compose. The coverage gate after Build pack is the point of the workflow: if the anchor is not in the corpus it refuses outright via `Not in library` rather than composing filler, and any candidate the model cannot tie to a real chunk_id is emitted under "Not from your library — my own suggestions:" instead of being cited. Run rows are written to obs.runs.
